claims.evidence: One source per (cell line x biological replicate): Fig. 1A "n=3" per line; Methods "Each labeled cell was prepared in biological triplicates"; mqpar experiments 1st/2nd/3rd = file suffix -1/-2/-3. Each replicate mix i contains HEK293 rep i (heavy), 786-O rep i (medium), Caki-1 rep i (light). The pairing of the three lines into mix i is by construction (one mix per experiment), not separately stated.

claims.location: assay name rows 1-81; comment[data file] rows 1-81
claims.evidence: files/all lists exactly 27 RAW + mqpar.xml; all 27 RAW are in mqpar filePaths (deposited names replace the "%" of "_3-23%.raw" with "_"). assay name = file stem (build default).

claims.value: SILAC heavy (HEK293) / SILAC medium (786-O) / SILAC light (Caki-1)
claims.evidence: Fig. 1A: "HEK-293 (Heavy)", "786-O (Medium)", "Caki-1 (Light)"; Methods: "HEK-293 and 786-O cell lines were grown in SILAC medium ... heavy = K8R10 ... medium = K4R6 ...; a normal DMEM medium (K0R0) was used for cells grown in light" (so Caki-1 = light). mqpar multiplicity 3, labelMods ["", "Arg6;Lys4", "Arg10;Lys8"] (rule 14 multiplexing verified). Author SDRF of PXD045898 agrees HEK293 = SILAC heavy but writes 786-O as "SILAC light" and Caki-1 as "label free sample" (a 3-channel run cannot hold a label-free sample) - overruled by the explicit figure + Methods. No deposited quantification table exists in either deposit, so no ratio check was possible (see limitations).
mqpar <fractions> 0..8 match file tags F0..F8; build numbers them 1..9 in the order F0..F8 per mix (fraction identifier must be a positive integer). Fig. 1A "High-pH fractionation".
Biological triplicates per labeled line (Methods, Fig. 1A legend "biological triplicates"); numbering restarts per factor group (cell line), replicate i = mqpar experiment i = file suffix -i.
Each mix/fraction was acquired once (one file per experiment x fraction in mqpar).
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; all three lines OX NCBI_TaxID=9606. NCBITaxon:9606 verified.

claims.evidence: Paper: HEK-293 and Caki-1 from Korea Cell Line Bank, 786-O from ATCC. Cellosaurus IDs HEK293 / 786-O / Caki-1. Ontology labels: EFO:0001182 HEK293; CLO:0001486 "786-O cell" / EFO:0005707 "786-0"; CLO:0002176 / BTO:0003204 "Caki-1 cell" / EFO:0002149 "Caki1" - the Cellosaurus names are written (validator warns for 786-O, Caki-1). Factor = cell line, the variable compared (786-O vs HEK-293, Caki-1 vs HEK-293, Caki-1 vs 786-O).

Paper: "kidney-derived cells"; Cellosaurus derived-from site kidney (HEK293 fetal kidney, 786-O kidney); Caki-1 is a ccRCC (kidney) tumour line whose cells were taken from a skin metastasis - recorded in sampling site. UBERON:0002113 verified.

Cellosaurus CC "Derived from site": HEK293 "In situ; Fetal kidney; UBERON_0002113"; 786-O "In situ; Kidney"; Caki-1 "Metastatic; Skin; UBERON_0002097". UBERON:0002113 kidney, UBERON:0002097 skin of body verified.

Cultured cell lines (Methods "Cell culture").
Cellosaurus AG: HEK293 "Fetus" (no numeric age - not available), 786-O 58Y, Caki-1 49Y.
Cellosaurus SX: HEK293 Female; 786-O Male; Caki-1 Male.
Cellosaurus AG Fetus -> UBERON:0007220 late embryonic stage (EFO-imported; same choice as curated HEK293 SDRFs in sdrf-annotated-datasets); 58Y and 49Y >= 20Y -> EFO:0001272 adult (rule 9).
Cellosaurus CC "Population: Caucasian." for 786-O and Caki-1 -> HANCESTRO:0005 European ancestry (same mapping as passed PXD004817); HEK293 has no population annotation.

Methods: all three lines "grown in high glucose containing Dulbecco modified Eagle medium (DMEM - high glucose)"; light = "normal DMEM medium (K0R0)"; the labelled lines in Thermo "SILAC medium" (formulation not named). NCIT:C185409 verified.
Methods: "the cell pellets were stored at -80 C until use".
MS shotgun proteomics (PRIDE experimentTypes PRIDE:0000429); written by build.
Raw headers: "LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS" instrument method; paper_cells "LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS/MS instrument". PRIDE instruments says the generic "LTQ Orbitrap" (MS:1000449) - raw beats PRIDE.
Raw method "Nth Order Double Play", "Scan Event 2 repeated for top 10 peaks"; paper "data-dependent analysis (DDA)".

limitations: PRIDE attaches PXD039207 to the wrong paper: PMID 37889066 (TMT6plex tissue study, data in PXD039204) contains no SILAC or cell-line content. The design comes from the paper of the byte-identical re-deposit PXD045898 (PMID 39467626), identified via PRIDE search and confirmed by file sizes, partial byte comparison of one RAW and an identical mqpar.xml. Full-file checksums were not compared (PRIDE gives no checksums for PXD045898).

Rule 6 ratio check not possible: neither deposit contains MaxQuant txt output (only mqpar.xml) and no RAW reader (ThermoRawFileParser/pyopenms/techsdrf) is installed. The channel map rests on Fig. 1A + Methods text, which agree; the author SDRF of PXD045898 agrees on HEK293 = heavy but uses wrong channel names for the other two lines.
Which replicate of each line went into mix 1/2/3 is implied by the design (one mix per biological replicate, mqpar experiments 1st/2nd/3rd) but not stated explicitly.

characteristics[disease] for 786-O follows Cellosaurus (renal cell carcinoma, NCIt C9385) although the paper calls it "primary ccRCC"; HEK293 written as normal per the paper's "normal group" (Cellosaurus lists no disease; the line is adenovirus-transformed).
Caki-1: organism part kidney (tumour origin) with sampling site skin of body (Cellosaurus metastatic site); a reviewer may prefer organism part = skin of body.
cell type, passage number not stated in any source -> not available. HEK293 age not numeric in Cellosaurus (Fetus) -> not available.
techsdrf not installed: instrument/analyzer/CID/scan range read from HTTP range reads of 4 RAW headers (all 4 identical method), not every file.
Fraction identifiers 1-9 map to file tags F0-F8 (MaxQuant fractions 0-8).

PXD039207 and PXD045898 are duplicate depositions of the same 27 runs; whoever assembles a corpus must pick one. The curated sdrf-annotated-datasets PXD045898 SDRF annotates these runs as label free, which is wrong (mqpar multiplicity 3).
